protocol.question: Does reducing only the ordinary GPU DFS arrays from 32 to 20 slots accelerate the complete production C2C RPC without cold or memory regressions?
protocol.candidate: Compile the ordinary nearest entry with static module text selecting 32 or 20 u32 node and f32 lower-bound slots; unchanged traversal/order, visit cap, point/node buffers and exact f64 verification. Ignore the compact flag for leaf, box or parent entry points. Rust/WASM unchanged.

sourceBound.note: Each internal build splits floor(n/2), ceil(n/2), with early coincident leaves only shortening depth. At most one deferred sibling per ancestor plus current node; capacity 20 leaves two slots above the 18-slot bound. This does not predict compiler resource usage or speed.

protocol.orderScheme: Alternate stack32/stack20 and stack20/stack32, six timed pairs per position. Retain all tails.
protocol.timed: Complete ordinary production RPC with diagnostics OFF: fresh query snapshot, GPU hints/readback, four exact streaming workers, ordered statistics, f32 export, ordinary asynchronous release submission and response transfer.
protocol.excluded: Parse/index, initial pool/device/reference/pipeline setup and CPU oracle checks.
protocol.coldScope: One freshly loaded reference per control after primary trials, device/pipelines and pool already prepared, parse/index outside RPC. Entire fresh-reference C2C RPC timed. Cold order stack32/stack20, stack20/stack32, stack32/stack20, stack20/stack32 across four reports. Single samples are a conservative regression guard, not a cold speedup estimate.
protocol.diagnosticScope: Two separate diagnostic-on explanatory pairs after two warm-up pairs. Excluded from adoption timing. No phase subtraction/sum isolates transfers; instrumentation may perturb times.
protocol.adoptionGate: All four primary reports must have median paired reduction >=1% and at least 7/12 faster pairs. Every cold stack20/stack32 RPC ratio must be <=1.05, and both controls must retain zero optional box/parent buffer bytes. Otherwise keep 32 slots by default.
protocol.correctness: Every f32 distance bit and ordered statistic equals indexed CPU oracle. Certificates stable per control. Untimed full f64/brute tests include real queries, exact hit, overflow guards, four workgroup sizes, inherited switches, cached compact switches, ignored flags on leaf/box/parent paths, independent uploads, buffered/concurrent snapshots, pipeline failure fallback/retry and shared map-failure recovery.
protocol.storage: No new reference buffers or CPU reference copies. Declared per-invocation arrays have logical sizes 256/160 bytes, not measured physical storage, occupancy or register counts. Optional box/parent bytes must stay zero for both timing controls.
protocol.wasmReuse: Require complete unchanged normalized Rust source set and four byte-identical generated WASM package artifacts; rebuild current frontend and verify provenance. CI performs fresh full WASM build.
protocol.safety: Unchanged byte-identical measured subsets, no adapter identity or private hardware labels, no new toolchains, no heavy work during timings; all earlier timing budgets remain closed.

interpretation: The 20-slot variant failed all four warmed adoption gates: +0.33% to +3.98% median paired RPC changes, with 13/48 faster pairs. The 32-slot traversal remains default. All tails remain, including the 629.9 ms PandaSet 2 compact trial. Optional box/parent storage is zero in both controls. Declared arrays are smaller but physical allocations, registers, spills, occupancy and node visits were not measured. Cold samples are descriptive conservative guards, not cold speedup estimates. Diagnostic timestamps are explanatory and excluded from adoption. Source-level storage reduction does not establish a GPU speedup. Exact f64 verification stays authoritative and certificates are not hint accuracy.
diagnosticAggregation: Add shaderMillis in batch order using left-to-right f64 addition, then take the median of the two explanatory operation sums.
